text.tspan: Storage classes: all 11 nines durable; they differ in availability, minimum days and retrieval
frequent access · ≥3 AZs, survives an AZ loss
unknown pattern · auto tiers · monitoring fee, no retrieval fee
infrequent but fast · DR, backups · retrieval fee
ONE AZ: data lost if the AZ is destroyed · re-creatable copies
archive read about once a quarter
Expedited 1-5 min · Standard 3-5 h · Bulk 5-12 h (free)
Standard within 12 h · Bulk within 48 h · cheapest, long-term
• Durability 99.999999999% (11 nines) for every class: store 10,000,000 objects → expect to lose one about every 10,000 years (course figure).
• Availability = how readily the data can be read; it varies by class (table). * Intelligent-Tiering optional archive tiers take hours.
• ** Glacier Flexible / Deep Archive: availability applies after you restore the object. Min billable size 128 KB (IA classes, Glacier IR).
• Glacier classes = storage price + retrieval cost. Move between classes manually or with lifecycle rules.
• Standard "sustains 2 concurrent facility failures" is the course wording; the docs say resilient to the loss of an entire AZ.
